quote.text_cn: “我他妈每天都能见到尼科斯，”她在录音中说道。“我要和他一起飞往巴黎。我要和他待上一整周……他爱我。亲爱的，我和他一起过了圣诞节，还有新年。明白吗？在格斯塔德，就是到处都一起。”
quote.text_en: "I see Nikos every f-ing day," she said in the recording. "I'm flying with him to Paris. I'm with him for a f-ing week.... He loves me. Honey, I spent Christmas with him. New Years. OK? Gstaad. Like, everywhere."
